summary: Vicor Corporation filed an 8-K on August 25, 2026, announcing a new board-approved share repurchase authorization of up to $150 million of its common stock, superseding the prior program. The program has no expiration date, imposes no obligation to acquire any specific amount, and may be suspended at the company's discretion. Repurchases may occur through open market transactions under Rule 10b-18 or Rule 10b5-1 plans, subject to market conditions and legal requirements. No price per share, premium, or close date was stated. The filing is a routine capital return announcement, not a tender offer. What to watch: execution pace and market impact under the new authorization.
